# Weird-files corpus

Hostile media samples live under `files/` (Git LFS). Each entry is described in
`manifest.json`. New playback bug → new file here, forever (Rule 4.3).

Seed target for Gate 0: ≥20 files covering 10-bit HEVC, AV1, interlaced MPEG-2,
ASS/SSA, PGS, odd audio layouts, VFR, broken moov, >4GB, HDR10, Dolby Vision P8.
